subject: english
question:
Choose the option that has an error in the sentence.

Children who does not read books will never be able to receive information in any way.

options.text: Children who does not read books
will never be able to receive

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "**Children who does not**." The subject "**Children**" is plural, and the verb must agree with it.
 
• The correct verb form for a plural subject is "**do not**" instead of "**does not**."
 
• Hence, the corrected phrase should be "**Children who do not read books**."
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Children who do not read books will never be able to receive information in any way."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "will never be able to receive"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "information in any way"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: No correction required** – This would be the correct option if the sentence had no errors, but there is an error in part 1 of the sentence.
